query:
SELECT m.*, ARRAY_AGG(mp.prov_count ORDER BY mp.map_file_id) "planes?: Vec<Option<i32>>"
                FROM maps_dom6 m
                LEFT JOIN map_planes mp ON mp.map_id=m.map_id
                INNER JOIN games g ON
                    g.maps_dom6_id =m.map_id AND
                    g.id=$1
                GROUP BY m.map_id
